
=== current/report.zh.txt [lines 42-82; total 239] ===
42: 
43: 固定监督目标B为原合同中的BCE＋逐查询排序损失＋0.5倍top5困难负例项。S对当前群和抽中的历史群都平均原视图与重组视图监督：
44:   Bbar_theta(g) = [B(s_A0,y) + B(s_A1,y)]/2。
45: 有历史群时，一次物理更新的目标是：
46:   J_S = Bbar_theta(g_current) + 0.1 Bbar_theta(g_history) + 0.5 D0。
47:   D0 = mean_{378对}[s_theta(A0)-s_birth(A0)]²。
48: 首阶段没有历史项。这里“birth”是该历史群进入存活缓存时保存的旧模型输出；不是另选一种外部模型，也不是第二个同时训练的教师网络。
49: 
50: R0采用同样记录架构、历史格式和原分组D0，只关闭A1监督。旧C则把历史教师权重分成0.25 D0＋0.25 D1；D1指相同历史表在重组A1上的旧评分约束。S的mse1虽然被计算和记录，却不进入其训练目标。不能把C的新增保持机制或C_cf的折外来源算作S的贡献。
51: 
52: 1.3 更新、缓存与计算作用
53: 冻结实现先在一次live encoder图上产生记录表示和记录对分数，再求目标对分数的导数，以512对分块重算确定性head，累计head和记录表示梯度，最后将记录梯度传回实际encoder。当前与历史两组梯度合并、裁剪到1后，一次AdamW更新。正式入口确实调用该路径，不是只计算指标的旁路。
54: 
55: A0/A1复用同一次记录编码和作用表，新增监督会改变记录对梯度的组合方式。它不是凭空增加独立历史观察；是在既有记录和关系标签上施加不同的训练约束。分块反传是适用链式法则的内存实现，不应作为新梯度理论。
56: 
57: 历史缓存为六个完整群的Algorithm R；文本、训练标签、FP32旧记录作用表及附属状态合计受1MiB实时上限约束。阶段结束时只为新存活群生成旧参考，仍存活的旧参考不刷新，淘汰群不重取。每条训练路径与归档快照必须分开解释。
58: 
59: 关键贡献边界：对S的实际训练目标，历史整张记录表只通过固定A0的378个账号对旧评分进入D0。代数上，若预先保存这378个投影值，D0需要的信息已经齐全；整表能回答其他分配的问题，但S不利用它们产生额外教师梯度。因此，“保存记录细节以生成新的历史教师查询”不是S已建立的创新。这里不是提出当场改变Memory；原格式用于匹配实验和诊断，浮点归约、格式、容量与恢复改动均未实施或实测。
60: 
61: 当前活动step28_record_replay.py相对归因实验冻结版新增了可选objective_fn接线，用于后续C_cf；本次核对差异仅为该可选参数与调用转发，默认S目标不变。冻结版SHA256为4b05a46f4b24a3a848b29a33be69f6ecc0ec9e00fa10c42f5d4fea8f98c3d73b，当前文件为ca3a7aadaa16d51e78d65d6e25fe714dcf1495b9bab60f2dce3b3cb8893e7f0d；不能声称两者同字节。本文数值对应冻结实验，不追改旧来源。
62: 
63: 2. 哪些数学性质成立，哪些不能升级成贡献
64: 
65: 2.1 两种“分组不变”必须区分
66: 账号内部记录的排列顺序不影响上述平均评分，这是架构的排列不变性。将记录移到另一个同控账号，会改变s_A；S仅监督两种分配都正确，没有要求s_A0=s_A1，也不保证交换后的分数或梯度严格不变。Deep Sets的集合排列结论不证明跨账号重分配合理。
67: 
68: 2.2 重组改变了哪些训练对象
69: 固定一次参数及记录表示，对一个总记录数为m的同控团，均匀无放回分配后，任意两个不同账号槽位间的期望评分等于该团全部不同记录对作用的平均：
70:   E_A s_ij = [1/(m(m-1))] sum_{r≠t∈团} K_theta(r,t)。
71: 理由是有序记录对分入这两个槽位的概率为n_i n_j/[m(m-1)]，再除以n_i n_j。不同控制者团之间，期望评分则为两个完整团记录池之间的平均作用。
72: 
73: 因此A1有可能减少模型对某一次账号记录分配的依赖，并训练来自不同原账号的记录组合。但每一步计算的是随机视图上的损失，非线性损失的平均不等于对平均分数求损失；实际过程也不是把每个团永久压成一个账号。这一推导不证明未见账号收益，更不构成新的重组原则。
74: 
75: 2.3 评分器仍有明确限制
76: 固定theta，对与Y不共享记录的两个记录袋X_a、X_b，其经验分布混合X_mix=alpha X_a+(1-alpha)X_b满足：
77:   s(X_mix,Y)=alpha s(X_a,Y)+(1-alpha)s(X_b,Y)。
78: 虽然K本身可以很复杂，最终账号评分对每侧经验分布仍是线性的。若两个纯记录袋各自与Y得分高，而混合袋应该因内部不相容而得分低，当前平均式不能额外表示这项混合惩罚。该局限不证明本数据需要更复杂评分器，也不证明LOGIT整体优于S；已有多实例模型也能引入上下文聚合，不能简单加attention便声称原创。
79: 
80: 3. 与已有方法的实质比较
81: 
82: 以下均核查一手论文的相应方法部分，范围见第8节；没有把检索摘要当完整方法审查，也没有声称穷尽截至今日所有文献。判断分别针对基本运算、具体任务化适配和已获实证。

20: def policy() -> dict:
21:     p = data.read_json(POLICY)
22:     if (p["methods"] != ["C", "S"] or p["orders"] != list(parent.ORDERS)
23:             or p["physical_updates"] != 4320 or p["gradient_group_presentations"] != 7776
24:             or p["pair_chunk"] != 512 or p["record_dimension"] != 2048
25:             or p["history_supervision"] != .1 or p["teacher_weight"] != .5
26:             or p["memory_maximum_bytes"] != 1048576):
27:         raise ValueError("Record replay contract differs")
28:     return p

31: def config() -> dict:
32:     c = copy.deepcopy(parent.config(parent.contract()))
33:     c["runtime"] = policy()["runtime"]
34:     # Reuse the pinned native loader, with this experiment's actual record head.
35:     c["interventions"]["split_rank"]["account_dim"] = 2048
36:     return c

39: def load_model(c: dict, device: str = "cuda:0") -> Any:
40:     return base.load_model(c, "split_rank", device)
41: 
42: 
43: def record_vectors(model: Any, group: data.Group, c: dict,
44:                    check: Callable = lambda: None) -> Any:
45:     import torch
46:     texts = base.record_texts(group, "separate_moments")
47:     device = next(model.parameters()).device
48:     parts = []
49:     for i in range(0, len(texts), c["input"]["microbatch"]):
50:         check()
51:         features = model.encoder.tokenizer(texts[i:i+c["input"]["microbatch"]],
52:             padding=True, truncation=False, return_tensors="pt")
53:         if features["input_ids"].shape[1] > c["input"]["token_budget"]:
54:             raise ValueError("Record exceeds frozen token budget; truncation forbidden")
55:         features = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in features.items()}
56:         autocast = (torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
57:                     if device.type == "cuda" else contextlib.nullcontext())
58:         with autocast:
59:             output = model.encoder(features)["sentence_embedding"]
60:         parts.append(output.float())
61:     channels = torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.cat(parts), dim=1)
62:     title, description = channels.chunk(2)
63:     return torch.cat((title, description), dim=1) / (2 ** .5)
64: 
65: 
66: def assignment(group: data.Group, seed: int | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
67:     """Record indices in frozen order; labels consulted only for training A1."""
68:     counts = list(map(len, group.items))
69:     slots = np.repeat(np.arange(28), counts)
70:     if seed is None:
71:         return slots
72:     if group.labels is None:
73:         raise ValueError("Regrouping requires authorized binary train labels")
74:     adjacency = np.eye(28, dtype=bool)
75:     left, right = np.triu_indices(28, 1)
76:     adjacency[left, right] = group.labels
77:     adjacency[right, left] = group.labels
78:     components, remaining = [], set(range(28))
79:     while remaining:
80:         component = np.flatnonzero(adjacency[min(remaining)]).tolist()
81:         if not set(component) <= remaining or not all(
82:                 np.array_equal(adjacency[j], adjacency[component[0]]) for j in component):
83:             raise ValueError("Positive labels must be disjoint cliques")
84:         remaining.difference_update(component)
85:         components.append(component)
86:     if sorted(map(len, components)) != [2]*8 + [3]*4:
87:         raise ValueError("Expected eight K2 and four K3")
88:     rng = random.Random(seed)
89:     result = slots.copy()
90:     for component in components:
91:         records = np.flatnonzero(np.isin(slots, component)).tolist()
92:         rng.shuffle(records)
93:         start = 0
94:         for account in component:
95:             result[records[start:start+counts[account]]] = account
96:             start += counts[account]
97:     if not np.array_equal(np.bincount(result, minlength=28), counts):
98:         raise ValueError("Record count conservation failed")
99:     return result
100: 
101: 
102: def pair_table(model: Any, z: Any, check: Callable = lambda: None) -> Any:
103:     import torch
104:     left, right = torch.triu_indices(len(z), len(z), 1, device=z.device)
105:     parts = []
106:     for start in range(0, len(left), 512):
107:         check()
108:         u, v = z[left[start:start+512]], z[right[start:start+512]]
109:         parts.append(model.head(torch.cat(((u-v).abs(), u*v), dim=1)).flatten())
110:     return torch.cat(parts)
111: 
112: 
113: def account_logits(table: Any, slots: np.ndarray) -> Any:
114:     import torch
115:     n = len(slots)
116:     if table.shape != (n*(n-1)//2,):
117:         raise ValueError("Complete off-diagonal record table required")
118:     left, right = torch.triu_indices(n, n, 1, device=table.device)
119:     matrix = table.new_zeros((n, n))
120:     matrix[left, right] = table
121:     matrix[right, left] = table
122:     assigned = torch.as_tensor(slots, device=table.device)
123:     pooling = torch.nn.functional.one_hot(assigned, 28).T.to(table.dtype)
124:     pooling = pooling / pooling.sum(1, keepdim=True)
125:     scores = pooling @ matrix @ pooling.T
126:     i, j = torch.triu_indices(28, 28, 1, device=table.device)
127:     return scores[i, j]
128: 
129: 
130: def objective(table: Any, group: data.Group, regroup_seed: int, arm: str,
131:               reference: np.ndarray | None = None) -> tuple[Any, dict]:
132:     import torch
133:     if arm not in ("C", "S", "R0") or group.labels is None:
134:         raise ValueError("Unknown arm or missing train labels")
135:     slots = [assignment(group)]
136:     if arm != "R0":
137:         slots.append(assignment(group, regroup_seed))
138:     predicted = [account_logits(table, a) for a in slots]
139:     truth = torch.tensor(group.labels, dtype=table.dtype, device=table.device)
140:     losses = [parent.ranking.objectives(v, truth, .5) for v in predicted]
141:     supervised = (losses[0]["total"] if arm == "R0" else
142:                   (losses[0]["total"] + losses[1]["total"]) / 2)
143:     mse = table.new_zeros(())
144:     mse0 = mse1 = mse
145:     if reference is not None:
146:         target = torch.as_tensor(reference, device=table.device, dtype=table.dtype)
147:         errors = [((p-account_logits(target, a))**2).mean()
148:                   for p, a in zip(predicted, slots)]
149:         mse0 = errors[0]
150:         if arm != "R0":
151:             mse1 = errors[1]
152:         mse = (mse0+mse1)/2 if arm == "C" else mse0
153:     result = supervised if reference is None else .1*supervised + .5*mse
154:     return result, {"supervised": float(supervised.detach()), "mse0": float(mse0.detach()),
155:                     "mse1": None if arm == "R0" else float(mse1.detach()), "distillation": float(mse.detach()),
156:                     "weighted": float(result.detach())}
157: 
158: 
159: def backward_group(model: Any, group: data.Group, c: dict, arm: str,
160:                    dropout_seed: int, regroup_seed: int, reference: np.ndarray | None,
161:                    check: Callable = lambda: None) -> dict:
162:     """One live encoder graph; exact chain rule through chunked deterministic head."""
163:     import torch
164:     torch.manual_seed(dropout_seed)
165:     z = record_vectors(model, group, c, check)
166:     with torch.no_grad():
167:         values = pair_table(model, z.detach(), check)
168:     proxy = values.detach().requires_grad_(True)
169:     loss, log = objective(proxy, group, regroup_seed, arm, reference)
170:     gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(loss, proxy)
171:     leaf = z.detach().requires_grad_(True)
172:     left, right = torch.triu_indices(len(z), len(z), 1, device=z.device)
173:     for start in range(0, len(left), 512):
174:         check()
175:         u, v = leaf[left[start:start+512]], leaf[right[start:start+512]]
176:         block = model.head(torch.cat(((u-v).abs(), u*v), dim=1)).flatten()
177:         block.backward(gradient[start:start+512])
178:     if leaf.grad is None or not torch.isfinite(leaf.grad).all():
179:         raise ValueError("Missing or nonfinite explicit dJ/dZ")
180:     z.backward(leaf.grad)
181:     log["record_gradient_norm"] = float(leaf.grad.norm())
182:     return log
183: 
184: 
185: def update(model: Any, optimizer: Any, current: data.Group, history: data.Group | None,
186:            reference: np.ndarray | None, c: dict, arm: str, order: str, stage: int,
187:            step: int, check: Callable = lambda: None, observe: Callable | None = None) -> dict:
188:     import torch
189:     model.train()
190:     optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
191:     optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"] = parent.stage_lr(step)
192:     optimizer.param_groups[1]["lr"] = .001
193:     logs = {}
194:     for role, group, target in (("current", current, None), ("history", history, reference)):
195:         if group is None:
196:             continue
197:         logs[role] = backward_group(model, group, c, arm,
198:             data.seed_for(20260918, order, stage, step, role, "dropout"),
199:             data.seed_for(20260918, order, stage, step, role, group.uid, "regroup"), target, check)
200:         if observe is not None:
201:             observe(role, logs[role])
202:     norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1., error_if_nonfinite=True)
203:     check()
204:     optimizer.step()
205:     return {**logs, "gradient_norm": float(norm), "encoder_lr": parent.stage_lr(step),
206:             "head_lr": .001, "total": sum(v["weighted"] for v in logs.values())}
207: 
208: 
209: def reference(model: Any, group: data.Group, c: dict, check: Callable = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:
210:     import torch
211:     model.eval()
212:     with torch.inference_mode():
213:         table = pair_table(model, record_vectors(model, group, c, check), check)
214:     result = table.float().cpu().numpy().copy()
215:     if not np.isfinite(result).all():
216:         raise ValueError("Nonfinite source table")
217:     return result

220: def score(model: Any, groups: list[data.Group], c: dict, check: Callable = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:

=== frozen_source/scripts/step28_record_replay.py [lines 220-330; total 330] ===
220: def score(model: Any, groups: list[data.Group], c: dict, check: Callable = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:
221:     import torch
222:     model.eval()
223:     with torch.inference_mode():
224:         rows = [account_logits(pair_table(model, record_vectors(model, g, c, check), check),
225:                                assignment(g)).float().cpu().numpy() for g in groups]
226:     result = np.stack(rows).astype(np.float32)
227:     if result.shape != (len(groups), 378) or not np.isfinite(result).all():
228:         raise ValueError("Incomplete blind scores")
229:     return result
230: 
231: 
232: class Memory:
233:     """Single bounded payload: UTF-8 groups/metadata followed by binary FP32 tables."""
234: 
235:     def __init__(self, order: str):
236:         if order not in parent.ORDERS:
237:             raise ValueError("Unknown order")
238:         self.order = order
239:         self.reservoir = data.Memory(data.seed_for(20260930, order, "retention"))
240:         self.tables: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
241:         self.origins: dict[str, int] = {}
242:         self.maps: dict = {}
243:         self.stage = self.count = 0
244:         self.draw_rng: random.Random | None = None
245: 
246:     def retain(self, current: list[data.Group], stage: int, teacher: Callable) -> dict:
247:         if (stage not in (1, 2) or len(current) != 48 or self.reservoir.seen != 48*(stage-1)
248:                 or (stage == 2 and (self.stage != 2 or self.count != 288))):
249:             raise ValueError("Retention boundary differs")
250:         old = {uid: hashlib.sha256(t.tobytes()).hexdigest() for uid, t in self.tables.items()}
251:         self.reservoir.add_stage(sorted(current, key=lambda g: g.uid))
252:         kept = {g.uid for g in self.reservoir.groups}
253:         self.tables = {uid: table for uid, table in self.tables.items() if uid in kept}
254:         self.origins = {uid: birth for uid, birth in self.origins.items() if uid in kept}
255:         new = []
256:         for group in self.reservoir.groups:
257:             if group.uid not in self.tables:
258:                 self.tables[group.uid] = np.asarray(teacher(group), dtype=np.float32).copy()
259:                 self.origins[group.uid] = stage
260:                 new.append(group.uid)
261:         for uid in kept & old.keys():
262:             if hashlib.sha256(self.tables[uid].tobytes()).hexdigest() != old[uid]:
263:                 raise ValueError("Survivor source was refreshed")
264:         self.stage = self.count = 0
265:         self.draw_rng = None
266:         self.to_bytes()
267:         return {"created": new, "evicted": sorted(old.keys()-kept), "survivors_unchanged": True}
268: 
269:     def begin_stage(self, stage: int) -> None:
270:         if stage not in (2, 3) or self.stage != 0 or self.reservoir.seen != 48*(stage-1):
271:             raise ValueError("History stage boundary differs")
272:         self.stage, self.count = stage, 0
273:         self.draw_rng = random.Random(data.seed_for(20260930, self.order, stage, "history_draws"))
274: 
275:     def draw(self) -> tuple[data.Group, np.ndarray]:
276:         if self.draw_rng is None or self.count >= 288 or len(self.reservoir.groups) != 6:
277:             raise ValueError("History draw boundary differs")
278:         group = self.draw_rng.choice(self.reservoir.groups)
279:         self.count += 1
280:         self.to_bytes()
281:         return group, self.tables[group.uid]
282: 
283:     def to_bytes(self) -> bytes:
284:         if set(self.tables) != {g.uid for g in self.reservoir.groups} or set(self.origins) != set(self.tables):
285:             raise ValueError("Historical groups/source alignment differs")
286:         blocks, records = [], []
287:         for group in self.reservoir.groups:
288:             n = sum(map(len, group.items))
289:             t = self.tables[group.uid]
290:             if t.shape != (n*(n-1)//2,) or t.dtype != np.float32 or not np.isfinite(t).all():
291:                 raise ValueError("Historical table shape, type or finiteness differs")
292:             blocks.append(t.astype("<f4", copy=False).tobytes())
293:             records.append({"uid": group.uid, "count": len(t), "origin": self.origins[group.uid]})
294:         header = data.json_bytes({"format": "record_table_f32_v1", "order": self.order,
295:             "reservoir": json.loads(self.reservoir.to_bytes()), "tables": records, "maps": self.maps,
296:             "stage": self.stage, "count": self.count,
297:             "draw_rng": self.draw_rng.getstate() if self.draw_rng else None})
298:         payload = struct.pack("<I", len(header)) + header + b"".join(blocks)
299:         if len(payload) > 1048576:
300:             raise ValueError("Entire historical state exceeds 1 MiB")
301:         return payload
302: 
303:     @classmethod
304:     def from_bytes(cls, payload: bytes) -> Memory:
305:         size, = struct.unpack("<I", payload[:4])
306:         obj = json.loads(payload[4:4+size])
307:         if obj["format"] != "record_table_f32_v1":
308:             raise ValueError("Unknown memory format")
309:         result = cls(obj["order"])
310:         result.reservoir = data.Memory.from_bytes(data.json_bytes(obj["reservoir"]))
311:         result.maps, result.stage, result.count = obj["maps"], obj["stage"], obj["count"]
312:         cursor = 4+size
313:         for row in obj["tables"]:
314:             end = cursor+4*row["count"]
315:             result.tables[row["uid"]] = np.frombuffer(payload[cursor:end], dtype="<f4").copy()
316:             result.origins[row["uid"]] = row["origin"]
317:             cursor = end
318:         if obj["draw_rng"] is not None:
319:             result.draw_rng = random.Random()
320:             result.draw_rng.setstate(data.tuple_state(obj["draw_rng"]))
321:         if cursor != len(payload) or result.to_bytes() != payload:
322:             raise ValueError("Full history payload did not roundtrip")
323:         return result
324: 
325:     def summary(self) -> dict:
326:         payload = self.to_bytes()
327:         return {"members": [g.uid for g in self.reservoir.groups], "seen": self.reservoir.seen,
328:                 "stage": self.stage, "count": self.count, "bytes": len(payload),
329:                 "origins": self.origins.copy(), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
330:                 "tables": {uid: hashlib.sha256(t.tobytes()).hexdigest() for uid, t in self.tables.items()}}

108: def train_stage(model: Any, optimizer: Any, current: list, memory: Any, valid: list,

122:         row = update(model, optimizer, group, history, target, c, arm, order, stage, step, budget.check)

26: def contract() -> dict:
27:     if data.sha256(POLICY) != POLICY_SHA256:
28:         raise ValueError("Ranking policy differs from the frozen contract")
29:     p = data.read_json(POLICY)
30:     if (p["arms"] != list(ARMS) or p["runs"] != list(RUNS)
31:             or p["physical_updates"] != 7776 or p["updates_per_run"] != 864
32:             or p["epochs"] != 6 or p["score_epochs"] != [3, 6] or p["primary_epoch"] != 6

65: 
66: def encoder_lr(policy: dict, arm: str, step: int) -> float:
67:     """One-based actual optimizer step; the final scheduled encoder rate is zero."""
68:     if arm not in ARMS or type(step) is not int or not 1 <= step <= policy["updates_per_run"]:
69:         raise ValueError("Unknown arm or update outside the fixed budget")
70:     if arm == "d":
71:         return 2e-5
72:     spec = policy["encoder_schedule"]
73:     warmup, total = spec["warmup_updates"], policy["updates_per_run"]
74:     if warmup != math.ceil(spec["warmup_fraction"] * total) or not 0 < warmup < total:
75:         raise ValueError("Invalid warmup schedule")
76:     factor = step / warmup if step <= warmup else (total - step) / (total - warmup)
77:     return float(spec["peak_lr"] * factor)
78: 
79: 
80: def set_learning_rate(optimizer: Any, policy: dict, arm: str, step: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
81:     if len(optimizer.param_groups) != 2:
82:         raise ValueError("Expected encoder and head optimizer groups")
83:     rates = (encoder_lr(policy, arm, step), policy["encoder_schedule"]["head_lr"])
84:     for group, rate in zip(optimizer.param_groups, rates, strict=True):
85:         group["lr"] = rate
86:     return rates
87: 
88: 
89: def hard_candidates(predicted: Any, truth: Any, count: int = 5) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
90:     """Known-negative indices only, deterministic exact-tie order, live score values."""
91:     import torch
92: 
93:     if predicted.shape != (378,) or truth.shape != (378,) or count != 5:
94:         raise ValueError("Expected 28-account scores and five hard negatives")
95:     # Independent shape/label/connectivity validation remains in base.objectives.
96:     if not torch.isfinite(predicted).all() or not torch.isin(truth, truth.new_tensor([0, 1])).all():
97:         raise ValueError("Nonfinite scores or nonbinary labels")
98:     left, right = torch.triu_indices(28, 28, 1, device=predicted.device)
99:     scores = predicted.new_zeros((28, 28))
100:     scores[left, right], scores[right, left] = predicted, predicted
101:     positive = torch.zeros((28, 28), dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
102:     positive[left, right], positive[right, left] = truth.bool(), truth.bool()
103:     negative = ~positive & ~torch.eye(28, dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
104:     if (positive.sum(1) < 1).any() or (negative.sum(1) < count).any():
105:         raise ValueError("Each query needs positive and known negative candidates")
106:     selected = torch.argsort(scores.detach().masked_fill(~negative, -torch.inf),
107:                              dim=1, descending=True, stable=True)[:, :count]
108:     if not negative.gather(1, selected).all():
109:         raise ValueError("Self or positive entered hard negatives")
110:     return scores, positive, selected
111: 
112: 
113: def objectives(predicted: Any, truth: Any, hard_weight: float) -> dict:
114:     import torch
115: 
116:     if hard_weight not in (0., .5):
117:         raise ValueError("Only disabled or approved fixed hard weight is allowed")
118:     result = base.objectives(predicted, truth, 1)
119:     if hard_weight == 0:
120:         return {**result, "hard": predicted.new_zeros(())}
121:     scores, positive, selected = hard_candidates(predicted, truth)
122:     terms = []
123:     for query in range(28):
124:         pos = scores[query, positive[query]]
125:         neg = scores[query, selected[query]]
126:         terms.append(torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg.unsqueeze(0) - pos.unsqueeze(1)).mean())
127:     hard = torch.stack(terms).mean()
128:     return {"bce": result["bce"], "rank": result["rank"], "hard": hard,
129:             "total": result["total"] + hard_weight * hard}
130: 
131: 
132: def score(model: Any, groups: list, config: dict, check: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:
133:     return base.score(model, groups, config, "split_rank", check)
134: 
135: 
136: def update(model: Any, optimizer: Any, group: Any, config: dict, policy: dict,
137:            arm: str, step: int, seed: int, *, observe: bool = False,
138:            check: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> dict:
139:     import torch
140: 
141:     if group.labels is None:
142:         raise ValueError("Only supervised fitting groups enter updates")
143:     if step == 1 and optimizer.state:
144:         raise ValueError("New run optimizer already has history")
145:     if step > 1 and (not optimizer.state or any(float(v["step"]) != step - 1
146:                                                for v in optimizer.state.values())):
147:         raise ValueError("Optimizer history does not match the declared update")
148:     rates = set_learning_rate(optimizer, policy, arm, step)
149:     if arm != "hard":
150:         # Exact original D computation. No extra forward/random draws/zero-loss graph.
151:         result = base.update(model, optimizer, group, config, "split_rank", seed,
152:                              observe=observe and rates[0] > 0, check=check)
153:         return {**result, "hard": 0., "step": step, "encoder_lr": rates[0], "head_lr": rates[1]}
154:     model.train()
155:     optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
156:     before = {name: core.state_digest(module.state_dict()) for name, module in
157:               (("encoder", model.encoder), ("head", model.head))} if observe else {}
158:     torch.manual_seed(seed)
159:     predicted = base.logits(model, group, config, "split_rank", check)
160:     truth = torch.tensor(group.labels, dtype=torch.float32, device=predicted.device)
161:     terms = objectives(predicted, truth, policy["hard_ranking"]["weight"])
162:     terms["total"].backward()
163:     evidence = {}
164:     if observe:
165:         for name, module in (("encoder", model.encoder), ("head", model.head)):
166:             norms = [float(p.grad.float().norm()) for p in module.parameters() if p.grad is not None]
167:             if not norms or not np.isfinite(norms).all() or max(norms) <= 0:
168:                 raise ValueError("Missing finite nonzero task gradient: " + name)
169:             evidence[name] = {"finite_nonzero_gradient": True}
170:     norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), config["optimizer"]["clip_norm"],
171:                                          error_if_nonfinite=True)
172:     check()
173:     optimizer.step()
174:     if observe:
175:         for name, module in (("encoder", model.encoder), ("head", model.head)):
176:             changed = before[name] != core.state_digest(module.state_dict())
177:             expected = name == "head" or rates[0] > 0
178:             if changed != expected:
179:                 raise ValueError("Actual update differs from learning-rate scope: " + name)
180:             evidence[name]["parameters_changed"] = changed
181:     return {**{name: float(terms[name].detach()) for name in LOSS_NAMES}, "modules": evidence,
182:             "gradient_norm": float(norm), "step": step, "encoder_lr": rates[0], "head_lr": rates[1]}
183: 
184: 
185: def paired_summary(deltas: np.ndarray, domains: list[str], evaluation: dict) -> dict:

208: def train(job: Path, budget: Any) -> tuple[dict, dict, list]:
209:     import torch
210:     root = job/"run"
211:     root.mkdir()
212:     for sub in ("models", "work", "memory", "points", "scores", "maps", "updates", "diagnostics"):
213:         (root/sub).mkdir()

216:     archive = core.model_files(base.model_config(config("R0"), "split_rank"))

218:            for k in ("file_count", "total_size_bytes", "content_sha256")):
219:         raise ValueError("Pretrained BGE differs")

222:         "pretrained_archive": archive, "partition": data.record(root/"partition.json", root),
223:         "points": {}, "training": {}, "diagnostics": {}, "starts": {}, "initial": {},
224:         "physical_updates": 0, "gradient_group_presentations": 0}

226:     groups["train"] = previous.parse_once(job, groups["train"], config("R0"), "train")
227:     selected, after = base.partition(groups, metadata, config("R0"))
228:     if after != partition:
229:         raise ValueError("Partition changed after supervision alignment")
230:     supply = parent.Supply(selected, partition)
231:     initial_digests = {}
232:     for order in parent.ORDERS:
233:         for arm in ARMS:
234:             c = config(arm)
235:             family = "LOGIT0.1" if arm == "LOGIT0.1" else "record"
236:             random.seed(c["initialization_seed"])
237:             np.random.seed(c["initialization_seed"])

239:             digest = core.state_digest(model.state_dict())
240:             if family in initial_digests and initial_digests[family] != digest:

244:             path = order+"_"+arm

246:                 "optimizer_sha256": core.state_digest(optimizer.state_dict()),

248:                 "memory": None, "family": family}
249:             if family not in manifest["initial"]:
250:                 with diagnostics.neutral(model):
251:                     raw = diagnostics.score(model, groups["development"], c, arm, budget.check)
252:                 manifest["initial"][family] = {
253:                     "model_sha256": digest, "valid_labels_used": False,
254:                     "raw": previous.save_array(root/"scores"/("initial_"+family+".npy"), raw, root)}
255:             # R0 and S each train their own first stage; neither branches from a trained peer.
256:             memory = None
257:             for stage in (1, 2, 3):
258:                 current, cal = supply.current(path, order, stage)
259:                 name = point_name(order, arm, stage)
260:                 log, diags = train_stage(model, optimizer, current, memory, groups["development"],
261:                     c, arm, order, stage, root, budget)
262:                 point, memory = checkpoint(root, name, model, optimizer, memory, current, cal,
263:                     groups["development"], c, arm, order, stage, budget)
264:                 manifest["training"][name], manifest["diagnostics"][name], manifest["points"][name] = log, diags, point
265:                 manifest["physical_updates"] += 288
266:                 manifest["gradient_group_presentations"] += 288 if stage == 1 else 576
267:                 data.write_json(root/"progress.json", manifest)
268:             del model, optimizer, current, cal, memory
269:             gc.collect()
270:             torch.cuda.empty_cache()

272:                     initial_model_digests=initial_digests)

=== frozen_source/scripts/step28_chinese_base.py [lines 89-193; total 880] ===
89: def model_config(c: dict, arm: str) -> dict:
90:     if arm not in ARMS:
91:         raise ValueError("Unknown model")
92:     return {"model": {**c["models"][arm], **c["input"]},
93:             "optimizer": c["optimizer"], "initialization_seed": c["initialization_seed"]}

95: 
96: def pooling_modes(pool: Any) -> list[str]:
97:     """Read actual native pooling across the installed and legacy module APIs."""
98:     mode = getattr(pool, "pooling_mode", None)
99:     if isinstance(mode, str):
100:         return [mode]
101:     if isinstance(mode, (tuple, list)) and all(isinstance(value, str) for value in mode):
102:         return list(mode)
103:     if mode is not None:
104:         raise ValueError("Unrecognized native pooling representation")
105:     names = {"pooling_mode_cls_token": "cls", "pooling_mode_mean_tokens": "mean"}
106:     return [names.get(key, key) for key, value in vars(pool).items()
107:             if key.startswith("pooling_mode_") and value is True]
108: 
109: 
110: def load_model(c: dict, arm: str, device: str = "cuda:0") -> Any:
111:     import torch
112:     from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
113:     m = c["models"][arm]
114:     torch.manual_seed(c["initialization_seed"])
115:     encoder = SentenceTransformer(str(data.ROOT / m["path"]), device=device,
116:                                   local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
117:     encoder.default_prompt_name = None
118:     encoder.max_seq_length = c["input"]["token_budget"]
119:     pools = [v for v in encoder if type(v).__name__ == "Pooling"]
120:     has_dense = any(type(v).__name__ == "Dense" for v in encoder)
121:     if len(pools) != 1 or has_dense != m["dense_module"]:
122:         raise ValueError("Native encoder modules differ from the registered model")
123:     pool = pools[0]
124:     if pooling_modes(pool) != [m["pooling"]] or encoder.get_sentence_embedding_dimension() != m["embedding_dim"]:
125:         raise ValueError("Native pooling or output dimension differs")
126:     if c["input"]["activation_checkpointing"]:
127:         encoder[0].auto_model.gradient_checkpointing_enable(
128:             gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={"use_reentrant": False, "preserve_rng_state": True})
129:     torch.manual_seed(c["initialization_seed"])
130:     return core.build_model(encoder, c["interventions"][arm]["account_dim"],
131:                             c["input"]["head_hidden"]).to(device)
132: 
133: 
134: def record_texts(group: data.Group, representation: str) -> list[str]:
135:     records = [row for items in group.items for row in items]
136:     if representation == "combined_mean":
137:         return [title + "\n" + description for _, title, description in records]
138:     if representation == "separate_moments":
139:         return [title for _, title, _ in records] + [description for _, _, description in records]
140:     raise ValueError("Unknown account representation")
141: 
142: 
143: def pool_channels(vectors: Any, counts: list[int], representation: str,
144:                   epsilon: float = 1e-8) -> Any:
145:     """Population moments, all items, with no ID/count/domain feature."""
146:     import torch
147:     if representation == "combined_mean":
148:         return core.pool_records(vectors, counts)
149:     if (representation != "separate_moments" or not counts or any(n <= 0 for n in counts)
150:             or len(vectors) != 2 * sum(counts) or epsilon != 1e-8):
151:         raise ValueError("Channel/account alignment or moment definition differs")
152:     normalized = torch.nn.functional.normalize(vectors.float(), dim=1)
153:     title, description = normalized.split(sum(counts))
154:     accounts = []
155:     for left, right in zip(title.split(counts), description.split(counts), strict=True):
156:         parts = []
157:         for channel in (left, right):
158:             mean = channel.mean(0)
159:             std = ((channel - mean).square().mean(0) + epsilon).sqrt()
160:             parts.extend((mean, std))
161:         accounts.append(torch.cat(parts))
162:     return torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.stack(accounts), dim=1)
163: 
164: 
165: def objectives(predicted: Any, truth: Any, rank_weight: float) -> dict:
166:     """Each query averages its positive logits, never positive or negative pairs twice in BCE."""
167:     import torch
168:     if (predicted.shape != (378,) or truth.shape != (378,)
169:             or not torch.isfinite(predicted).all() or not torch.isin(truth, truth.new_tensor([0, 1])).all()
170:             or int(truth.sum()) != 20 or rank_weight not in (0, 1)):
171:         raise ValueError("Expected complete finite 28-account supervision and fixed loss weight")
172:     left, right = torch.triu_indices(28, 28, 1, device=predicted.device)
173:     positive = torch.zeros((28, 28), dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
174:     positive[left, right] = truth.bool()
175:     positive[right, left] = truth.bool()
176:     degrees = positive.sum(1)
177:     if (int((degrees == 1).sum()) != 16 or int((degrees == 2).sum()) != 12):
178:         raise ValueError("Expected eight two-alias and four three-alias positive components")
179:     # Same-controller labels must be transitive; a degree-two cycle is not a controller.
180:     paths = positive.float() @ positive.float()
181:     diagonal = torch.eye(28, dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
182:     if ((paths > 0) & ~positive & ~diagonal).any():
183:         raise ValueError("Positive relations are not disjoint controller cliques")
184:     scores = predicted.new_zeros((28, 28))
185:     scores[left, right] = predicted
186:     scores[right, left] = predicted
187:     log_denominator = torch.logsumexp(scores.masked_fill(diagonal, -torch.inf), dim=1)
188:     positive_mean = scores.masked_fill(~positive, 0).sum(1) / degrees
189:     rank = (log_denominator - positive_mean).mean()
190:     bce = torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(predicted, truth, reduction="mean")
191:     return {"bce": bce, "rank": rank, "total": bce + rank_weight * rank}
192: 
193: 

=== frozen_source/scripts/step28_alias_ranking.py [lines 89-129; total 222] ===
89: def hard_candidates(predicted: Any, truth: Any, count: int = 5) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
90:     """Known-negative indices only, deterministic exact-tie order, live score values."""
91:     import torch
92: 
93:     if predicted.shape != (378,) or truth.shape != (378,) or count != 5:
94:         raise ValueError("Expected 28-account scores and five hard negatives")
95:     # Independent shape/label/connectivity validation remains in base.objectives.
96:     if not torch.isfinite(predicted).all() or not torch.isin(truth, truth.new_tensor([0, 1])).all():
97:         raise ValueError("Nonfinite scores or nonbinary labels")
98:     left, right = torch.triu_indices(28, 28, 1, device=predicted.device)
99:     scores = predicted.new_zeros((28, 28))
100:     scores[left, right], scores[right, left] = predicted, predicted
101:     positive = torch.zeros((28, 28), dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
102:     positive[left, right], positive[right, left] = truth.bool(), truth.bool()
103:     negative = ~positive & ~torch.eye(28, dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
104:     if (positive.sum(1) < 1).any() or (negative.sum(1) < count).any():
105:         raise ValueError("Each query needs positive and known negative candidates")
106:     selected = torch.argsort(scores.detach().masked_fill(~negative, -torch.inf),
107:                              dim=1, descending=True, stable=True)[:, :count]
108:     if not negative.gather(1, selected).all():
109:         raise ValueError("Self or positive entered hard negatives")
110:     return scores, positive, selected
111: 
112: 
113: def objectives(predicted: Any, truth: Any, hard_weight: float) -> dict:
114:     import torch
115: 
116:     if hard_weight not in (0., .5):
117:         raise ValueError("Only disabled or approved fixed hard weight is allowed")
118:     result = base.objectives(predicted, truth, 1)
119:     if hard_weight == 0:
120:         return {**result, "hard": predicted.new_zeros(())}
121:     scores, positive, selected = hard_candidates(predicted, truth)
122:     terms = []
123:     for query in range(28):
124:         pos = scores[query, positive[query]]
125:         neg = scores[query, selected[query]]
126:         terms.append(torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg.unsqueeze(0) - pos.unsqueeze(1)).mean())
127:     hard = torch.stack(terms).mean()
128:     return {"bce": result["bce"], "rank": result["rank"], "hard": hard,
129:             "total": result["total"] + hard_weight * hard}

=== current_source/step28_continual_expression_data.py [lines 84-136; total 369] ===
84: def preference(rng: random.Random, weights: list[float]) -> tuple[int, int]:
85:     first = weighted_index(rng, weights)
86:     remaining = weights.copy()
87:     remaining[first] = 0.0
88:     second = weighted_index(rng, remaining)
89:     return tuple(sorted((first, second)))
90: 
91: 
92: def inherit_preference(
93:     rng: random.Random, parent: tuple[int, int], weights: list[float], probability: float
94: ) -> tuple[int, int]:
95:     # A redraw equal to the parent is valid; never retry it.
96:     return parent if rng.random() < probability else preference(rng, weights)
97: 
98: 
99: def inherit_style(rng: random.Random, parent: int, size: int, probability: float) -> int:
100:     return parent if rng.random() < probability else rng.randrange(size)
101: 
102: 
103: def public_override(rng: random.Random, personal: int, public: list[int], probability: float) -> int:
104:     """One account-axis draw, independent of ownership/pair labels and item count."""
105:     return public[rng.randrange(len(public))] if rng.random() < probability else personal
106: 
107: 
108: def subcategories(catalog: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
109:     return [sub for topic in catalog["topics"] for sub in topic["subcategories"]]
110: 
111: 
112: def valid_text(text: str, limit: int) -> bool:
113:     return bool(text) and len(text) <= limit and all(
114:         ord(char) <= 0xFFFF and not 0xD800 <= ord(char) <= 0xDFFF
115:         and (ord(char) >= 32 or char in "\n\t")
116:         for char in text
117:     )
118: 
119: 
120: def render(
121:     rng: random.Random, catalog: dict[str, Any], sub_index: int, style: tuple[int, ...]
122: ) -> tuple[str, str]:
123:     sub = subcategories(catalog)[sub_index]
124:     product = rng.choice(sub["products"])
125:     title = catalog["title_templates"][style[0]].format(
126:         product=product, qualifier=rng.choice(catalog["qualifiers"])
127:     )
128:     description = catalog["description_templates"][style[1]].format(
129:         intro=rng.choice(catalog["intros"]).format(product=product),
130:         detail=rng.choice(sub["details"]),
131:         packaging=rng.choice(catalog["packaging"]),
132:         delivery=rng.choice(catalog["delivery"]),
133:         service=rng.choice(catalog["service_phrases"][style[2]]),
134:     )
135:     return title, description

=== current_source/step28_continual_expression_data.py [lines 216-280; total 369] ===
216: def make_group(
217:     policy: dict[str, Any], catalog: dict[str, Any], domain: str, split: str, index: int
218: ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, str]], list[dict[str, str]]]:
219:     seed = policy["root_seed"]
220:     context = (domain, split, index)
221:     group_uid = opaque_id(seed, *context, "group")
222:     weights = [weight / 4 for weight in policy["domains"][domain] for _ in range(4)]
223:     sizes = [int(size) for size, count in sorted(policy["controller_alias_counts"].items())
224:              for _ in range(count)]
225:     stream(seed, *context, "alias_counts").shuffle(sizes)
226:     account_ids = [opaque_id(seed, *context, "account", n) for n in range(sum(sizes))]
227:     stream(seed, *context, "id_assignment").shuffle(account_ids)
228:     item_numbers = sorted(map(int, policy["item_count_pmf"]))
229:     count_weights = [policy["item_count_pmf"][str(n)] for n in item_numbers]
230:     items: list[dict[str, str]] = []
231:     owners: list[dict[str, str]] = []
232:     account_slot = 0
233:     for controller, size in enumerate(sizes):
234:         controller_uid = opaque_id(seed, *context, "controller", controller)
235:         parent = preference(stream(seed, *context, "controller_preference", controller), weights)
236:         parent_style = tuple(stream(seed, *context, "controller_style", controller, axis)
237:                              .randrange(n) for axis, n in enumerate(policy["style_axis_sizes"]))
238:         for alias in range(size):
239:             seller_uid = account_ids[account_slot]
240:             account_slot += 1
241:             account_context = (*context, controller, alias)
242:             own_preference = inherit_preference(
243:                 stream(seed, *account_context, "account_preference"), parent,
244:                 weights, policy["preference_inheritance"]
245:             )
246:             style = tuple(inherit_style(
247:                 stream(seed, *account_context, "account_style", axis), parent_style[axis],
248:                 n, policy["preference_inheritance"]
249:             ) for axis, n in enumerate(policy["style_axis_sizes"]))
250:             style = tuple(public_override(
251:                 stream(seed, *account_context, "public_style", axis), personal,
252:                 policy["public_style_indices"][axis],
253:                 policy["public_style_probability"][domain][axis]
254:             ) for axis, personal in enumerate(style))
255:             number = item_numbers[weighted_index(
256:                 stream(seed, *account_context, "item_count"), count_weights)]
257:             owners.append(dict(group_uid=group_uid, seller_uid=seller_uid,
258:                                controller_uid=controller_uid))
259:             for item in range(number):
260:                 category_rng = stream(seed, *account_context, "item_category", item)
261:                 if category_rng.random() < policy["preferred_item_probability"]:
262:                     sub_index = category_rng.choice(own_preference)
263:                 else:
264:                     sub_index = weighted_index(category_rng, weights)
265:                 title, description = render(
266:                     stream(seed, *account_context, "item_wording", item), catalog, sub_index, style
267:                 )
268:                 require(valid_text(title, 48) and valid_text(description, 720), "Rendered text")
269:                 items.append(dict(
270:                     group_uid=group_uid, seller_uid=seller_uid,
271:                     item_uid=opaque_id(seed, *account_context, "item_id", item),
272:                     title=title, description=description
273:                 ))
274:     items.sort(key=lambda row: (row["seller_uid"], row["item_uid"]))
275:     owners.sort(key=lambda row: row["seller_uid"])
276:     group = dict(domain=domain, split=split, group_uid=group_uid, group_index=index,
277:                  accounts=len(owners), items=len(items))
278:     return group, items, owners
279:

70: def stage_lr(step: int) -> float:
71:     if type(step) is not int or not 1 <= step <= 288:
72:         raise ValueError("Stage step must be one-based in 1..288")
73:     return 1e-5 * (step / 29 if step <= 29 else (288 - step) / 259)

76: def schedule(current: list, policy: dict, order: str, stage: int) -> tuple[list, int]:
77:     if order not in ORDERS or stage not in (1, 2, 3) or len(current) != 48:
78:         raise ValueError("Only the 48 current fitting groups enter a stage")
79:     if len({g.uid for g in current}) != 48 or any(g.labels is None for g in current):
80:         raise ValueError("Missing or repeated current supervision")
81:     stream = data.seed_for(policy["schedule_seed"], order, stage, "current")

85: class Supply:
86:     """Offline dispatcher. Never pass this object or its full archive to a learner."""
87: 
88:     def __init__(self, groups: dict, partition: dict):
89:         self.groups, self.partition = groups, partition
90:         self.next_stage: dict[str, int] = {}
91:         self.orders: dict[str, str] = {}
92:         seen = set()
93:         for role, count in (("fit", 48), ("calibration", 12)):
94:             rows = partition[role]
95:             if len(rows) != 3 * count:
96:                 raise ValueError("Incomplete dispatcher partition")
97:             for group, row in zip(groups[role], rows, strict=True):
98:                 if (group.uid != row["group_uid"] or row["domain"] not in "ABC"
99:                         or group.uid in seen or group.labels is None):
100:                     raise ValueError("Dispatcher identity, supervision or role separation differs")
101:                 seen.add(group.uid)
102:             if any(sum(row["domain"] == d for row in rows) != count for d in "ABC"):
103:                 raise ValueError("Dispatcher domain sizes differ")
104: 
105:     def current(self, path: str, order: str, stage: int) -> tuple[list, list]:
106:         if (order not in ORDERS or stage != self.next_stage.get(path, 1)
107:                 or self.orders.get(path, order) != order):
108:             raise ValueError("Future, old or repeated stage request")
109:         if stage not in (1, 2, 3):
110:             raise ValueError("No fourth domain")
111:         result = []
112:         for role, count in (("fit", 48), ("calibration", 12)):
113:             selected = [g for g, row in zip(self.groups[role], self.partition[role], strict=True)
114:                         if row["domain"] == order[stage - 1]]
115:             if len(selected) != count:
116:                 raise ValueError("Current domain role count differs")
117:             result.append(selected)
118:         self.next_stage[path] = stage + 1
119:         self.orders[path] = order
120:         return result[0], result[1]
121: 
122:     def branch_after_first(self, path: str, shared_path: str) -> None:
123:         if path in self.next_stage or self.next_stage.get(shared_path) != 2:
124:             raise ValueError("Branches must start from one completed first stage")
125:         self.next_stage[path] = 2
126:         self.orders[path] = self.orders[shared_path]

=== frozen_source/scripts/step28_continual_population.py [lines 1-130; total 210] ===
1: """Trainable item/account pooling and symmetric pure-text pair classification."""
2: from __future__ import annotations
3: 
4: import contextlib
5: import hashlib
6: from pathlib import Path
7: from typing import Any, Callable
8: 
9: import numpy as np
10: 
11: import step28_continual_population_data as data
12: 
13: 
14: def build_model(encoder: Any, dimension: int, hidden: int = 128) -> Any:
15:     import torch
16: 
17:     class PairModel(torch.nn.Module):
18:         def __init__(self) -> None:
19:             super().__init__()
20:             self.encoder = encoder
21:             self.head = torch.nn.Sequential(torch.nn.Linear(dimension * 2, hidden),
22:                                             torch.nn.ReLU(), torch.nn.Linear(hidden, 1))
23: 
24:         def pair_logits(self, accounts: Any) -> Any:
25:             left, right = torch.triu_indices(len(accounts), len(accounts), 1, device=accounts.device)
26:             u, v = accounts[left], accounts[right]
27:             return self.head(torch.cat(((u - v).abs(), u * v), dim=1)).flatten()
28: 
29:     return PairModel()
30: 
31: 
32: def make_optimizer(model: Any, config: dict) -> Any:
33:     import torch
34:     p = config["optimizer"]
35:     return torch.optim.AdamW(
36:         [{"params": model.encoder.parameters(), "lr": p["encoder_lr"],
37:           "weight_decay": p["encoder_weight_decay"]},
38:          {"params": model.head.parameters(), "lr": p["head_lr"],
39:           "weight_decay": p["head_weight_decay"]}],
40:         betas=tuple(p["betas"]), eps=p["eps"], foreach=p["foreach"])
41: 
42: 
43: def model_files(config: dict) -> dict:
44:     base = data.ROOT / config["model"]["path"]
45:     rows = [{"path": path.relative_to(base).as_posix(), "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
46:              "sha256": data.sha256(path)}
47:             for path in sorted(base.rglob("*"), key=lambda p: p.relative_to(base).as_posix())
48:             if path.is_file() and ".cache" not in path.parts and "__pycache__" not in path.parts
49:             and path.suffix != ".pyc"]
50:     # Preserve step7's canonical_hash: size_bytes keys and no trailing newline.
51:     content = hashlib.sha256(data.json_bytes(rows).rstrip(b"\n")).hexdigest()
52:     return {"files": rows, "file_count": len(rows),
53:             "total_size_bytes": sum(row["size_bytes"] for row in rows), "content_sha256": content}
54: 
55: 
56: def load_model(config: dict, device: str = "cuda:0") -> Any:
57:     import torch
58:     from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
59: 
60:     torch.manual_seed(config["initialization_seed"])
61:     encoder = SentenceTransformer(str(data.ROOT / config["model"]["path"]),
62:                                   device=device, local_files_only=True)
63:     encoder.default_prompt_name = None
64:     encoder.max_seq_length = config["model"]["token_budget"]
65:     if encoder.get_sentence_embedding_dimension() != config["model"]["embedding_dim"]:
66:         raise ValueError("LaBSE embedding dimension differs")
67:     if config["model"]["activation_checkpointing"]:
68:         encoder[0].auto_model.gradient_checkpointing_enable(
69:             gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={"use_reentrant": False, "preserve_rng_state": True})
70:     # Head initialization must not depend on encoder loader's incidental RNG use.
71:     torch.manual_seed(config["initialization_seed"])
72:     return build_model(encoder, config["model"]["embedding_dim"], config["model"]["pair_head"][1]).to(device)
73: 
74: 
75: def pool_records(vectors: Any, counts: list[int]) -> Any:
76:     import torch
77:     if sum(counts) != len(vectors) or any(n <= 0 for n in counts):
78:         raise ValueError("Record/account alignment differs")
79:     normalized = torch.nn.functional.normalize(vectors.float(), dim=1)
80:     means = torch.stack([chunk.mean(dim=0) for chunk in normalized.split(counts)])
81:     return torch.nn.functional.normalize(means, dim=1)
82: 
83: 
84: def account_vectors(model: Any, group: data.Group, config: dict,
85:                     check_budget: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> Any:
86:     import torch
87:     device = next(model.parameters()).device
88:     texts = [title + "\n" + description for rows in group.items for _, title, description in rows]
89:     counts = list(map(len, group.items))
90:     size = config["model"]["microbatch"]
91:     blocks = []
92:     for start in range(0, len(texts), size):
93:         check_budget()
94:         batch = texts[start:start + size]
95:         # Do not use SentenceTransformer.tokenize: it silently truncates long input.
96:         features = model.encoder.tokenizer(batch, padding=True, truncation=False, return_tensors="pt")
97:         if features["input_ids"].shape[1] > config["model"]["token_budget"]:
98:             raise ValueError("An item exceeds the frozen token budget")
99:         features = {key: value.to(device) for key, value in features.items()}
100:         context = (torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
101:                    if device.type == "cuda" and config["model"]["encoder_bf16"] else contextlib.nullcontext())
102:         with context:
103:             vectors = model.encoder(features)["sentence_embedding"]
104:         blocks.append(vectors.float())
105:     return pool_records(torch.cat(blocks), counts)
106: 
107: 
108: def logits(model: Any, group: data.Group, config: dict,
109:            check_budget: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> Any:
110:     return model.pair_logits(account_vectors(model, group, config, check_budget))
111: 
112: 
113: def backward_group(model: Any, group: data.Group, config: dict, seed: int,
114:                    check_budget: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> float:
115:     import torch
116:     if group.labels is None:
117:         raise ValueError("Training requires authorized current/replay supervision")
118:     torch.manual_seed(seed)
119:     predicted = logits(model, group, config, check_budget)
120:     truth = torch.tensor(group.labels, dtype=torch.float32, device=predicted.device)
121:     if predicted.shape != truth.shape or not torch.isfinite(predicted).all():
122:         raise ValueError("Nonfinite or misaligned train logits")
123:     loss = torch.nn.functional.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(predicted, truth, reduction="mean")
124:     loss.backward()
125:     return float(loss.detach())
126: 
127: 
128: def update(model: Any, optimizer: Any, current: data.Group, replay: data.Group | None,
129:            config: dict, current_seed: int, replay_seed: int,
130:            check_budget: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> dict:

=== context/AGENTS.md [lines 1-24; total 24] ===
1: # 科研 Agent 执行入口
2: 
3: 本文件保留必要边界与导航；常设规则集中在[科研纪律](docs/RESEARCH_DISCIPLINE.zh.md)，运行状态集中在[当前交接](docs/AI_RESEARCH_HANDOFF.zh.md)顶部。本文件不记录进度。
4: 
5: ## 按任务读取
6: 
7: | 本轮工作 | 需要的上下文 |
8: |---|---|
9: | 首次接手或上下文恢复 | 科研纪律第1—4节、交接顶部；按任务补读下列条款。恢复还须按第7节核对实际文件与相关作业，不能只信摘要 |
10: | 文字、规则、链接维护 | 受影响条款及直接来源；纪律第5、10节。已有且仍适用的上下文复用，不为每次编辑通读历史 |
11: | 科研实现、执行或结果分析 | 现行合同与明确补充、实际入口／直接依赖、相关原始审查；纪律第5—8节。由[设计入口](docs/CURRENT_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN.md)定位，不递归加载全仓库 |
12: | 文件同步、保管、清理、Git交付 | 纪律第7、9、10节及[存储记录](docs/STORAGE.zh.md)；先查实际对象和已有许可 |
13: 
14: ## 必守边界
15: 
16: - 先辨对象、时间和范围：最新明确用户决定优先，当前合同及补充决定执行边界。历史“待授权”不恢复成当前阻断，旧批准不扩大到新动作；冻结原件和已发生事实不追改。
17: - 已确认范围内持续完成实现、观察、针对性验证、修复和交付，不按普通步骤重复确认。有影响执行的不确定或冲突时先核对已有决定，仍不能解消则附出处与影响询问，只暂停依赖工作；新增研究、数据权限、比较、预算或判据须确认。
18: - 防止过度设计贯穿执行：新增代码、测试或流程须对应本轮具体缺口，复用适用证据，必要核验充分后停止。交付前实际撤回、合并或简化无关扩展与重复改动，不另造自查报告；外审建议也按范围和证据处置，不自动全部实现。
19: - 技术读取、结果开放、依据结果作选择是三种权限。文件小、只读、归档存在均不授予数据／标签权限；未来域、test／owners、封存材料及private_custody按合同隔离，失败账不清零。

48: 比较 | O：最终旧域 | N：新域学完表现

53: （1）记录系统贡献了一部分旧域收益，重组监督在相同记录系统上又带来额外O/N收益。
54: R0−LOGIT同时改变文本如何表示、如何给记录对和账号对打分、head函数与维数、历史参考形式及计算路径。因此归因对象是整个记录表示／评分系统，不能缩写成“只靠pooling”或“只靠Memory”。S−R0更接近重组策略的比较，但包含整条训练轨迹及其历史参考的后续变化；没有分别拆出当前群重组、历史群重组或唯一因果机制。三臂沿LOGIT→R0→S的差值可以相加，不等于已测得普适贡献百分比或排除了结构与重组交互。
55: 
56: （2）N的收益主要在第三阶段，不能写成每次到新域都学得更快。
57: S−R0的A2为+0.001072676，区间[-0.009891257,0.012091655]；Z为+0.030924452，区间[0.016795443,0.045505259]。N=(A2+Z)/2，两个保存均值的贡献分别约0.000536338与0.015462226。G的区间跨零，N是学完后的水平，G才是学习前后差，二者不能混称。
58: 
59: （3）首学代价和个别域例外仍在。
60: 首域刚学完平均MAP：R0为0.489001504，S为0.474387958；到最后该首域平均：R0为0.471269342，S为0.487233535。因此S的负遗忘部分受较低首学起点影响，但最终O优势不只是这个算术现象。CAB中的首域C最终S=0.473051542、R0=0.474697468，S仍略低。九个顺序×实际域格子中八个最终均值较高只是描述，不是九次独立确认。
61: 
62: （4）S未触发严格过拟合信号，不是证明过拟合已被消除。
63: 按MAP／Recall@5／raw log_loss依次，fit严格信号数为LOGIT 1/2/2、R0 0/1/2、S 0/0/0；cache为LOGIT 5/3/2、R0 2/1/1、S 0/0/0。每臂fit各指标9个可用面板，cache各8个；首阶段cache及CAB第三阶段无残存C群的格子为不适用，不能算零。
64: S仍有七项点估计呈现相应形状但区间证据不足：
65: - ABC stage3，cache A的MAP；cache B的MAP。
66: - BCA stage2，fit C的raw log_loss；cache B的MAP、Recall@5、raw log_loss。
67: - BCA stage3，cache B的Recall@5。
68: 此外CAB S stage1的raw log_loss，fit为0.244397471→0.328736684，valid为0.244247565→0.351011393，均变差。严格诊断要求训练端改善才可能触发，所以这里不触发不代表概率拟合良好。该现象、完整曲线及有限诊断定义必须同时报告，不新增事后早停或判据。
69: 
70: （5）排序改善真实存在，概率与固定阈值的代价不能隐藏。
71: 14项排序指标在raw、stage-cal、first-cal中一致，已核对的正仿射校准保持排序，所以主要MAP提升不是校准制造的。S相对LOGIT的raw log_loss在O/N/Z均更差，但raw Brier反而改善；不能概括成所有原始概率指标都退化。stage-cal的O/N log_loss与Brier改善也要同时保留。
72: 旧域O按既定阈值合并固定顺序／域出现位置的计数：
73: 方法 | TP | FP | FN | TN
74: LOGIT0.1 | 195 | 82 | 2205 | 42878
75: R0 | 194 | 100 | 2206 | 42860
76: S | 241 | 137 | 2159 | 42823
77: S相对R0多47个真阳性，同时多37个假阳性；O specificity差-0.000861266，区间[-0.001396648,-0.000325885]。这些是相关的固定出现位置汇总，不是新增独立样本。S的O召回率约10.04%、群宏F1约0.167，不能凭MAP改进宣称已达到实际自动识别要求。
78: S−R0的N Recall@5区间仍跨零，部分其他检索和ROC-AUC指标也未建立严格改善；MAP优势不能写成22指标全面提升。

14: ## 必守边界
15: 
16: - 先辨对象、时间和范围：最新明确用户决定优先，当前合同及补充决定执行边界。历史“待授权”不恢复成当前阻断，旧批准不扩大到新动作；冻结原件和已发生事实不追改。
17: - 已确认范围内持续完成实现、观察、针对性验证、修复和交付，不按普通步骤重复确认。有影响执行的不确定或冲突时先核对已有决定，仍不能解消则附出处与影响询问，只暂停依赖工作；新增研究、数据权限、比较、预算或判据须确认。
18: - 防止过度设计贯穿执行：新增代码、测试或流程须对应本轮具体缺口，复用适用证据，必要核验充分后停止。交付前实际撤回、合并或简化无关扩展与重复改动，不另造自查报告；外审建议也按范围和证据处置，不自动全部实现。
19: - 技术读取、结果开放、依据结果作选择是三种权限。文件小、只读、归档存在均不授予数据／标签权限；未来域、test／owners、封存材料及private_custody按合同隔离，失败账不清零。
20: - 科研实现／测试、指标重算、重采样、载模推理／训练只用Linux既有py310；Windows限编辑、文件管理及获准证据的机械核对。共享Linux先查归属和资源，不动他人作业；密码只作SSH认证。SFTP／SCP同步，Git仅在Windows使用。
21: - 禁止伪实现：从用户要求追踪实际输入、目标、梯度／更新、恢复和评价，关键操作须接入实际入口并产生约定作用；按科研纪律第5节核验，须能识别关键操作缺失。组件存在、PASS、哈希、测试数量或退出码不能替代实际行为证据，更不授予正式运行。保留有效负结果、原验收和外推边界。
22: - 实质科研方案／实现／评价／结论默认本地Playwright MCP网页GPT 6 Pro外审，主执行者独立处置；不用ComputerUse／CUA替代。纯文档维护免审，其他免审仅限明确范围。新运行用独立目录；已有监听不重复启动，故障按现行合同处理。
23: 
24: 执行、等待、失败与完成条件见科研纪律第2、5、7、10节。用户原话与历史证据分别从[讨论记录](docs/RESEARCH_DISCUSSION.zh.md)和[交接历史入口](docs/AI_RESEARCH_HANDOFF.zh.md#历史与证据)按需回溯。

=== frozen_source/docs/SELLER_ALIAS_RECORD_ATTRIBUTION.zh.md [lines 1-50; total 97] ===
1: # 记录模型与重组监督：三臂归因实验合同
2: 
3: 2026-10-09。用户在三臂归因建议后明确回复：“那就按照你说的继续吧，有细节需要澄清的就问我”。随后针对本合同具体范围确认“同意上述预算与读取范围（推荐）”及“按归因诊断分别判读（推荐）”。本轮为 LOGIT0.1、去掉重组监督的记录模型 R0、原 S，s0、ABC/BCA/CAB，共 7,776 次更新；新增预算、train／valid 各一次及归因判读均已确认。完成受影响实现、必要核验和网页外审／主审后执行正式实验；五臂旧许可和本次数值修复免审均不转移到本研究。
4: 
5: ## 1. 要回答的问题
6: 
7: 原 C/S 相对 LOGIT 的差异同时包含记录表示／配对结构和重组监督，不能据旧比较判断哪一部分起作用；C−S 没有建立原主问题所需的主要旧域增量，C_plus 是已关闭的固定配置负结果。本轮拆开前两个因素，为下一步方法设计提供证据，不将消融本身包装成创新算法，也不承诺本轮解决整体研究问题。
8: 
9: 研究对象仍为：有限历史训练信息下，依次学习新卖家群体，并保持对旧分布未见卖家的候选排序／基础识别。继续使用已选 BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5（revision 79e7739b6ab944e86d6171e44d24c997fc1e0116）；“历史目标”是该路径过去保存的数值评分，不是另一个预训练模型。
10: 
11: 固定两个主要比较：R0−LOGIT0.1 回答整套记录表示及评分结构相对旧账号汇总系统的效果；S−R0 回答加入同控重组监督的增量。S−LOGIT0.1 是预先列出的系统总差异。后者不能证明更复杂的方法更有效，前者也不是只改变一个池化算子的严格单因素实验：头维度、函数族、历史目标表示、计算量及跨架构 dropout 路径都有区别。不增加计算量匹配对照、纯 SEQ、C、C_plus 或 S_strong。
12: 
13: ## 2. 三臂实际计算
14: 
15: 继承[原 C/S 合同](SELLER_ALIAS_RECORD_REPLAY_PILOT.zh.md)和[LOGIT0.1 合同](SELLER_ALIAS_LOGIT_LOW.zh.md)中本节明确采用的输入、优化器、损失、记忆和评价定义。B 为 BCE＋query-rank＋0.5 known-top5-hard。A0 是记录仍属于原账号；A1 是仅在同控连通分量内打乱完整记录、按原账号条数重新分配。B0=B(A0)，Bbar=(B(A0)+B(A1))/2。D0 是当前模型与本路径保存的历史评分在原分组下的 378 项 raw logit 均方误差。
16: 
17: | 臂 | 当前群监督 | 历史群监督与评分保持 | 结构 |
18: |---|---|---|---|
19: | LOGIT0.1 | B0 | 0.1 B0＋0.5 D0 | 原账号均值／标准差表示及原配对头 |
20: | R0 | B0 | 0.1 B0＋0.5 D0 | 原 C/S 的记录表示、记录对头与账号汇总；训练不构造 A1 |
21: | S | Bbar | 0.1 Bbar＋0.5 D0 | 与 R0 完全相同的记录结构，沿用原 S 的重组监督 |
22: 
23: 首阶段没有历史项。后两阶段每步当前与历史各一群，梯度累加后一次 clip=1、一次 AdamW；不按监督视图数额外增加优化器更新。R0 不计算两份相同 B0 再平均，不把 A1 的日志存在当成增强生效。S 的两视图共享同一次 live encoder 表示与记录对表，监督平均而非相加翻倍。记录表 VJP 继续从损失经 dJ/dK、分块头、dJ/dZ 回传 live BGE；标题／描述分别归一化后拼接除以 √2，2,048 维记录表示，头 4,096→128→1；LOGIT 维持原 4,096 维账号表示、8,192→128→1 头。
24: 
25: R0/S 使用相同完整记录表 Memory 格式、同样六群和 1MiB 上限，仅 D0 进入历史保持目标。保留完整表是为了使 S−R0 只切换重组监督，并复用既有记忆实现；不是声称 R0 需要使用所有表项，也不据本轮宣布该记忆表示最节省。两臂各自在自己的阶段末产生新留存群的历史目标，存活旧目标不刷新，淘汰群不从档案恢复；不能共用已分化模型的目标。LOGIT 仍保存原 378 项账号分数。
26: 
27: ## 3. 起点、供给和实际工作量
28: 
29: 三臂均从同一已选 BGE 预训练归档重新开始三阶段，不复用旧训练权重。R0/S 头结构和初始化逐位相同，但首阶段监督不同，必须分别完成首阶段，不共享已训练的 S 首阶段模型／Adam／Memory。三个顺序的未训练同架构起点相同；跨架构只要求同 BGE、既定 seed 和各自固定头，不伪称完整参数或 dropout 张量逐位配对。
30: 
31: 沿用 initialization=20260909、current schedule=20260918、memory=20260930，s0 及 ABC/BCA/CAB；保留各自现有命名 dropout 流，R0/S 不以臂名改变随机流。当前群顺序、历史群抽样和模型无关 Algorithm R 成员在三臂配对。每阶段每域 48 fit 群、六轮、288 更新，Adam 连续到 288／576／864；阶段学习率重按原日程。
32: 
33: 总计 3臂×3顺序×3阶段×288＝7,776 物理更新，12,960 次梯度群呈现，27 个物理／逻辑阶段状态，162 个实际 epoch 诊断点，不存在 shared 首阶段别名。另按两个未训练架构各保存一份 60 群 raw 盲预测，R0/S 共同引用相同记录起点；这是起点观察，不多训练路径、不选初始化。每个阶段保留本路径当前 12 校准群的映射、首域固定映射、全 60 valid 的 raw／stage-cal／first-cal 分数。
34: 
35: 所有实际执行入口在载模前调用公共 configure_numerics 并保存生效值：deterministic=True、warn_only=False、CUDA matmul TF32=False、cuDNN TF32=False、cuDNN benchmark=False，Python 启动前 CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8。原生核验与正式运行都记录；不靠模块导入的副作用。不以本轮新结果修补历史 LOGIT R1 或声称已隔离其根因。
36: 
37: ## 4. 数据和三种权限
38: 
39: 固定数据为 reports/seller_alias_continual/20260910/expression_generation/20260910_150500/data，每域 48 fit／12 calibration／20 development-valid。模型输入仍仅屏蔽后的标题和描述，全部 2—8 条记录／账号、28 账号／群、最大 224 记录，256 token 上限、microbatch 4、BF16 encoder 和 FP32 参数／头／梯度／Adam；不截断、不将 UID、域或控制者作为模型特征。
40: 
41: - 技术读取：本轮新 train 标签解析尝试一次，由离线调度器按阶段供给，学习器只取得当前 fit 和自身存活记忆，校准器只取得当前域 12 群。valid 文本仅用于无标签前向；全部训练及盲门通过后 valid 标签解析尝试一次。失败也记账。test、owners、Audit、private_custody 为零；不读取旧 Memory 正文来恢复训练，不生成新数据或留出。
42: - 结果开放：7,776 更新、27 次完整阶段恢复、162 份六轮诊断、两个未训练盲起点及全部来源／预算／分数检查完成后，统一开放一次 valid 结果。先完整保存指标与计数，再比较。不看中途 valid 指标，不选最好 epoch，不提前停止取有利模型。可查看训练损失、fit／缓存诊断和资源，但不据其更改实验。
43: - 根据结果选择：本轮没有可自适应调整的候选、系数、种子或轮数。三组比较完整报告后结束，只形成后续研究建议；任何下一轮训练另行明确范围。反复使用的开发 valid 与已用基础 test 不会变为独立确认集。
44: 
45: ## 5. 过拟合诊断和阶段完整性
46: 
47: 实际训练循环每 48 次更新调用保留的通用诊断：A0／eval／无 autograd，当前 48 fit、当前存活缓存（首阶段为零，后续六群）和全 60 valid。fit／缓存保存 MAP、Recall@5 和原评价器的截断概率 log_loss；valid 只盲存 raw 预测，完整结束后统一评价。cache 按实际出生域与对应 valid 比较，缺失域为 N/A；固定 epoch1→6 及全部六点，不把遗忘、欠拟合、校准变化与过拟合混称。
48: 
49: 复用通用诊断现有的记录表 D0/D1 残差输出，R0 的 D1 只在无梯度、状态中性的诊断中计算，绝不进入 R0 训练目标。保留它不授予新增比较或选模型权限；不将残差称为梯度夹角或泛化机制证明。诊断须保持参数、已有梯度、Adam、所有子模块模式、Python／NumPy／Torch 随机状态、Memory 成员／目标／抽样状态不变，且不改变下一次实际更新。

18: 2. C_cf相对完整S的收益裁决
19: 
20: 主要终点为学习B结束后的A旧域及B新域未见账号MAP；三臂同款中文BGE，完整S配置保持。
21: 
22:                          A旧域MAP       B新域MAP
23: 完整S                    0.494131716    0.505870437
24: C_cf                     0.489917573    0.498875081
25: C_perm                   0.490960832    0.500162668
26: 
27: C_cf−S：A为−0.004214143，条件95%区间[−0.015758150,+0.006392627]；B为−0.006995356，区间[−0.017560005,+0.003951017]。
28: C_cf−C_perm：A为−0.001043259，区间[−0.008232223,+0.006165310]；B为−0.001287588，区间[−0.006410982,+0.003630643]。
29: 
30: 四个点估计均偏低、区间均跨零，因此本配置未提供预定改进证据；未证明总体劣效或等效。相对共享A末，三臂的A MAP点估计均未净下降，S也有同样现象，不能把C_cf末态接近A末归作其独有的防遗忘贡献。
31: 
32: 局部收益仍如实保留：raw概率Brier／裁剪log_loss两域较S低且相应条件区间全负。但stage-cal同样给S校准后，候选log_loss两域更高，B域Brier也更高；first-cal沿用A映射时，两域概率误差更高。first-cal虽提高召回与F1，合并误报207对49、precision约0.4567对0.6288；raw提高后的合并召回也仅3.375%。这不是主要排序收益，更不能概括为整体校准更好。
33: 
34: 独立使用成本为S的576更新／864梯度群呈现，对比C_cf含辅助来源的864／1152，即更新多50%、呈现多1/3；不宣称墙钟或FLOPs比例。当前六群末态Memory由348,167降至242,541字节，少105,626字节、约30.3377%。它是本批存储收益，没有在本合同中换成更多历史群，也没有建立排序收益。
35: 
36: 3. C_perm对照的准确解释
37: 
38: C_cf保存一批由全域来源F与未训练本群的来源O共同支持的“正候选应比负候选至少高多少”的下限。C_perm沿用同一批下限数值，在规定的小块中改绑到其他可行负候选，并保证F在出生时仍满足约束。O仍参与决定下限数值和启用数目，因此C_perm没有移除折外信息。
39: 
40: 本结果只支持：没有证据表明原来的具体对应关系比这一份固定可行错配更好。不能推出两臂等效、任意打乱都一样、O没有信息或整个cross-fitting家族无效。错配还改变出生松弛、O支持、候选难度和后续有效强度；即便某次原赋值胜过错配，也不能只据此证明O来源独立必要。一次固定错配不构成总体置换检验。
41: 
42: C_cf−S同时改变保持对象、惩罚几何与有效强度，回答的是整体候选替换是否获益，不能单独归因于其中一个成分。完整S已有记录结构和重组监督的收益不计入C_cf贡献。
43: 
44: 4. 采纳的补充：差距扩大与判据未触发必须同时报告

54: 本次既逐字比较两个数值替换，也比较了其余训练、保存、诊断与评价代码的 AST。formal_gate 同时保留当前 source_files 与原 verification_source_files；没有把旧资格的来源散列篡改为新散列，也没有声称因时限变化重跑了原生核验。新快照的另外两项是本次授权和监听脚本，不是新科研计算来源。[E3]
55: 
56: authorization_72h.json 明确记录用户“同意将正式上限改为72小时”，且三臂、7,776 更新、12,960 梯度群呈现、27 状态、162 诊断、48 GiB 输出、28 GiB CUDA reserved、64 GiB RSS、train／valid 各一次和不自动重试均不变。因此合同正文保留的 48 小时是旧条款，被本次具体补充替代；不能据此把已获准的当前运行误判为超出权限。[E2]
57: 
58: 3.2 原生资格的实质与限度
59: 
60: 原始回执中的三臂均为 N=224 条记录，标题／描述各 256 token，使用项目的实际 BGE／BF16／checkpoint 更新部件。每臂包含首次实际更新与两次从同一模型／Adam／RNG 状态出发的配对后续更新；三臂合计 9 次实际更新、15 次梯度群呈现。编码器与两层 head 的实际梯度／参数变化及 model／Adam／grad 逐字节一致记录，与当前 native 实现中的调用、恢复和比较位置对应。[E3]
61: 
62: 每臂比较 1,967 个张量；LOGIT 为 1,303,136,653 个元素，R0/S 各为 1,301,039,501 个元素。这里的 Adam 阶段计数 288 是明示的手写延续夹具，不表示核验前真的训练了 288 步。原生只核对实际最大形状部件和插入诊断后的后续更新中性；完整 48／6／60 群 capture 的调度与中性证据复用已关闭 CPU／实现审查，不把部件核验说成完整正式流程预演。[E3、E8]
63: 
64: 原生内部耗时 285.477382 秒，Torch 2.9.1+cu130、CUDA build 13.0、RTX 5090 的描述来自包内项目记录。网页审查没有重做这些张量运算。
65: 
66: 用保存组件时间直接机械复算预算：训练 145,552.560180 秒，纯前向 55,130.462512 秒，小数组保存代理 4.777624 秒，加 3,600 秒预留后乘 1.25，恰得 255,359.750395 秒，即约 70.933264 小时。该值大于原 48 小时、小于获准的 72 小时；存储投影 45,428,115,383 字节约 42.31 GiB。原生资格后对 48 小时的停止是正式启动前的预算拒绝，不是一次已消费 train 读取的正式失败。70.93 小时是最坏合法形状投影，不是正式实际耗时，也不能据二者差异推断某个数值开关或算法的运行时根因。[E3]
67: 
68: 3.3 成功退出之外的运行证据
69: 
70: wrapper 记录 2026-10-09 20:59:05（+08:00）启动、2026-10-11 00:24:33 退出，exit_code=0，外层 98,728 秒，即 27 小时 25 分 28 秒。预算末账为 98,727.018326 秒，约一秒差来自记录边界；两者均未触及 72 小时。[E4]
71: 
72: 正式入口先校验来源／资格／资源，在载模前调用 configure_numerics，保存的生效值为 deterministic_algorithms=true、warn_only=false、两项 TF32=false、cuDNN benchmark=false、CUBLAS=:4096:8。实际配置函数确实调用 PyTorch 设置并读回，并非仅构造外观正确的字典。这里证明的是当前入口和当前保存记录的对应，不回填历史五臂运行当时未知的数值状态。[E3、E4、E8]
73: 
74: 独立检查覆盖九条独立路径、27 个阶段的全部 7,776 条更新记录。每阶段 288 行；LOGIT 逐步 Adam 计数与阶段端计数、三臂学习率、当前／历史 UID、损失分解均一致。R0 的 mse1 均为 null，实际目标只构造 A0；S 保留重组监督而保持项仍只用 D0。总梯度群呈现为 12,960。三个顺序中 R0/S 的未训练 model／optimizer／RNG 记录一致，同架构跨顺序起点一致；没有共享训练后的首阶段。[E4]
75: 
76: 全部当前六轮顺序以冻结 seed 重新生成，并独立重放元数据层面的 Algorithm R 六群保留和每阶段 288 次历史索引抽样；三臂当前／历史供给及成员配对一致。只读保留成员 UID、出生阶段与目标散列；没有打开 Memory 载荷。存活目标的保存散列沿阶段保持不变，且属于各臂自己的学习轨迹。27 份 Memory 的记录最大为 352,863 字节，小于 1 MiB；不能把全部快照合并成学习器可读取的额外历史。[E4]
77: 
78: stdout 中 351 条 update 事件的 point／step 顺序完整对应 27 阶段的 step1、24、48、…、288。监听保存的 first_update 与首条事件完全相同；启动／退出／自删记录彼此衔接。其余 18 个非空非 JSON 行是同一方法更名 FutureWarning 及源码提示，没有在包中发现 failure.json。没有据退出码单独推定训练有效。[E4]
79: 
80: 四、27 次恢复、162 诊断与一次读取账
81: 
82: 实际 checkpoint 在阶段末保存并恢复 model／Adam／RNG／Memory，重新评分 12 个校准群及 60 个 valid 群，只有逐位相等才登记 full_restore_verified。之后保留推理模型和分数，并删除临时完整 checkpoint。27 个阶段记录的恢复项均为真，阶段点 JSON 与 manifest 完全一致。[E4]
83: 
84: 在本包可独立检查的范围内，27 个 epoch6 盲分数数组与对应阶段 raw 分数逐位相同，共 612,360 个分数；epoch6 的 3 项 valid 指标也与阶段原始指标列逐位一致。27 份模型、27 份 Memory 的清单记录与阶段引用身份一致，分别合计 35,237,126,610 和 8,389,549 字节。模型及 Memory 本体没有上传，本审查未独立重算这些载荷的 SHA 或再次恢复模型；核验的是包内声明的身份对应、实际源代码断言和保存结果的一致性。[E4、E10]
85: 
86: 27 阶段均有 epoch1—6 六条诊断，共 162；每条诊断的阶段／Adam 步、当前 48 fit 群、阶段存活缓存、全 60 valid 顺序均与分区和日志对应。首阶段缓存为空，后续为六群。valid_labels_used=false 的盲分数与已开放后的保存指标分开存在。另有两份未训练架构盲起点，R0/S 引用共同的 record 起点，不增加第三个架构起点或训练路径。[E4、E6]
87: 
88: 实际 execute 顺序是 train → blind_gate → before_valid → parse_once(development) → collect 全指标／计数 → diagnostics.evaluate → finalize → completion。parse_once 在打开标签前先记账，失败也算一次尝试。before_valid 中 train=1、valid=0；最终 access 和 completion 均为 train=1、valid=1、heldout=0、owners=0。上述调用关系、原始记录和分数链没有发现相互矛盾。[E4]
89: 
90: 这是一轮作业内的晚开放和一次解析账；valid 在整个研究中已被重复使用。一次本轮解析不使它变成全研究未见的独立确认集。也不能把这份应用层账提升成操作系统层面所有历史访问的独立证明；本轮没有要求、也不需要为了这个限定结论新造系统审计框架。

=== frozen_source/scripts/step28_continual_population_data.py [lines 66-104; total 258] ===
66: class Group:
67:     uid: str
68:     sellers: tuple[str, ...]
69:     # (item UID, title, description), account order matches sellers exactly.
70:     items: tuple[tuple[tuple[str, str, str], ...], ...]
71:     labels: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
72: 
73:     def validate(self, accounts: int = 28) -> None:
74:         if (len(self.sellers) != accounts or self.sellers != tuple(sorted(set(self.sellers)))
75:                 or len(self.items) != accounts):
76:             raise ValueError("Account identities or alignment differ")
77:         item_ids = []
78:         for rows in self.items:
79:             if not 2 <= len(rows) <= 8 or rows != tuple(sorted(rows)):
80:                 raise ValueError("Record multiplicity/order differs")
81:             for uid, title, description in rows:
82:                 if not uid or not title or not description:
83:                     raise ValueError("Empty public item")
84:                 item_ids.append(uid)
85:         if len(item_ids) != len(set(item_ids)):
86:             raise ValueError("Repeated item identity")
87:         if self.labels is not None:
88:             if len(self.labels) != accounts * (accounts - 1) // 2:
89:                 raise ValueError("Incomplete pair labels")
90:             if any(type(v) is not int or v not in (0, 1) for v in self.labels):
91:                 raise ValueError("Nonbinary supervision")
92: 
93:     def payload(self) -> dict:
94:         return asdict(self)
95: 
96:     @classmethod
97:     def restore(cls, value: dict) -> Group:
98:         result = cls(value["uid"], tuple(value["sellers"]),
99:                      tuple(tuple(tuple(row) for row in rows) for rows in value["items"]),
100:                      None if value["labels"] is None else tuple(value["labels"]))
101:         result.validate()
102:         return result
103: 
104: 

=== frozen_source/scripts/step28_continual_population_data.py [lines 198-258; total 258] ===
198: def tuple_state(value: Any) -> Any:
199:     return tuple(tuple_state(v) for v in value) if isinstance(value, list) else value
200: 
201: 
202: class Memory:
203:     """Algorithm R; all retained contents and selection RNG count toward bytes."""
204: 
205:     def __init__(self, seed: int, capacity: int = 6, maximum_bytes: int = 1048576):
206:         self.rng = random.Random(seed)
207:         self.capacity, self.maximum_bytes = capacity, maximum_bytes
208:         self.seen = 0
209:         self.groups: list[Group] = []
210: 
211:     def add_stage(self, current: list[Group]) -> None:
212:         # The runner supplies disjoint frozen stages exactly once. No all-history ID set.
213:         if len({g.uid for g in current}) != len(current) or {g.uid for g in current} & {g.uid for g in self.groups}:
214:             raise ValueError("Repeated current group")
215:         for group in current:
216:             if group.labels is None:
217:                 raise ValueError("Replay lacks authorized binary labels")
218:             self.seen += 1
219:             index = len(self.groups) if len(self.groups) < self.capacity else self.rng.randrange(self.seen)
220:             if index < self.capacity:
221:                 if index == len(self.groups):
222:                     self.groups.append(group)
223:                 else:
224:                     self.groups[index] = group
225:         self.to_bytes()
226: 
227:     def to_bytes(self) -> bytes:
228:         result = json_bytes({"capacity": self.capacity, "maximum_bytes": self.maximum_bytes,
229:                              "seen": self.seen, "rng": self.rng.getstate(),
230:                              "groups": [g.payload() for g in self.groups]})
231:         if len(result) > self.maximum_bytes:
232:             raise ValueError("Historical state exceeds the approved byte budget")
233:         return result
234: 
235:     @classmethod
236:     def from_bytes(cls, payload: bytes) -> Memory:
237:         obj = json.loads(payload)
238:         result = cls(0, obj["capacity"], obj["maximum_bytes"])
239:         result.seen = obj["seen"]
240:         result.rng.setstate(tuple_state(obj["rng"]))
241:         result.groups = [Group.restore(row) for row in obj["groups"]]
242:         if len(result.groups) != min(result.capacity, result.seen) or result.to_bytes() != payload:
243:             raise ValueError("Memory serialization differs")
244:         return result
245: 
246: 
247: def seed_for(seed: int, *parts: Any) -> int:
248:     return int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(json_bytes([seed, *parts])).digest()[:8], "big") % (2**63 - 1)
249: 
250: 
251: def schedule(groups: list[Group], epochs: int, seed: int) -> list[Group]:
252:     rng = random.Random(seed)
253:     result = []
254:     for _ in range(epochs):
255:         rows = sorted(groups, key=lambda g: g.uid)
256:         rng.shuffle(rows)
257:         result.extend(rows)
258:     return result

=== evidence/attribution_external.zh.txt [lines 129-155; total 363] ===
129: 6.1 经核对的主要 MAP 差值
130: 
131: 比较 | O 差值 [条件95%区间] | N 差值 [条件95%区间] | Z 差值 [条件95%区间]
132: R0−LOGIT0.1 | +0.010473228 [0.001575118, 0.019370052] | +0.000984269 [-0.009008174, 0.010438589] | -0.004765650 [-0.018544047, 0.008818927]
133: S−R0 | +0.016435877 [0.005107917, 0.028173005] | +0.015998564 [0.006573217, 0.025871752] | +0.030924452 [0.016795443, 0.045505259]
134: S−LOGIT0.1 | +0.026909104 [0.015890726, 0.038316505] | +0.016982833 [0.004613102, 0.029339358] | +0.026158801 [0.009328718, 0.043351296]
135: 
136: 第一组支持“记录结构系统带来旧域 O 的平均 MAP 收益”；新域 N、最终最新域 Z 的方向未确定。R0−LOGIT0.1 的 O Recall@5、ROC-AUC 也有正向区间，可作为同一固定条件下的辅助描述，但不能据此说全部新域能力无代价。R0−LOGIT 的 final_all MAP 区间也跨零；O 正向不是所有总体或逐域指标均正向。[E5]
137: 
138: 第二组支持“在相同记录架构之上，加入重组监督这一整体策略使 O/N 平均 MAP 提高”。S−R0 三顺序 O 点差为 +0.022689682、+0.020313467、+0.006304481；N 为 +0.037562423、+0.001745797、+0.008687471。方向在这三个固定顺序的均值上相同，但 BCA 的 N 增量很小。不能把这个一致方向称为跨 seed 稳定优势或逐实际域保护。[E5]
139: 
140: 第三组确认 S 相对 LOGIT0.1 的系统总差异。O 的 +2.690910 MAP 百分点可以分解成当前路径中的 +1.047323（R0−LOGIT）和 +1.643588（S−R0）；这是同一批保存输出上的线性差值分解。未设置“账号结构＋重组”的第四臂，不能识别结构与重组交互，也不能给出交换干预顺序后的贡献或普遍因果贡献百分比。
141: 
142: 6.2 两个差异各自包括什么
143: 
144: R0−LOGIT0.1 同时改变记录／账号的汇总顺序、head 输入维度和函数族、历史目标表示及计算／dropout 路径。因此“整套记录结构系统效果”是准确表述；“纯池化收益”“单独是记录 Memory 更好”或“已隔离某一算子根因”均超出本轮识别能力。
145: 
146: S−R0 共享记录架构、未训练起点、样本供给和更新预算，改变当前群与历史群的 A0/A1 平均监督；后续自身保存的历史评分也随轨迹改变。因此可识别的是“加入重组监督策略”的整体增量，不能只归因于当前重组、历史重组或固定教师下的直接效应。没有新增独立预训练教师；“历史目标”仍是该路径过去保存的数值。[E2、E4]
147: 
148: 6.3 N 的增量主要来自 Z，不能改写成学得更快
149: 
150: S−R0 的 A2 MAP 差为 +0.001072676，区间 [-0.009891257, 0.012091655]；Z 差为 +0.030924452，区间全正。由 N=(A2+Z)/2，N 的 +0.015998564 中，A2 的半权贡献为 +0.000536338，Z 的半权贡献为 +0.015462226。这支持“本轮平均新域收益主要出现在第三阶段”，而不是第二、第三阶段同样受益。[E5]
151: 
152: 第二阶段新域的 S−R0 点差分别为：ABC 的 B +0.022623006、BCA 的 C -0.012410267、CAB 的 A -0.006994712；第三阶段新域则分别为 +0.052501840、+0.015901862、+0.024369654。这是完整既定单元的描述，不添加逐单元显著性结论。
153: 
154: S−R0 的 G MAP 差为 -0.000293983，区间 [-0.011498040, 0.010855946]，方向未确定。根据定义，ΔN=ΔG＋学习新域前平均水平的差；该学前水平点差约 +0.016292547。此代数关系与“此前阶段迁移／学前状态／后续轨迹共同作用”相容，不能进一步确认其中哪个机制。N 更高不能写成每次新域学习增量更大或学习更快。主执行者在这一点上的保留是正确的。
155:

=== evidence/record_static_primary.zh.txt [lines 64-116; total 116] ===
64: 四、决定性研究问题：新增查询是否对应真实需要
65: 
66: 已直接读取包内generation/step28_continual_expression_data.py的public_override、render、make_group及catalog的标题/描述/服务样式。make_group在账号记录循环外固定账号style；public_override按账号/轴独立发生，render逐条使用该style。这支持账号固定样式的判断，不支持旧群级共因假说。此处仅读生成源码与公共生成资源，没有读owners或正式记录。
67: 
68: 独立手算：同控两个账号各两条，某个可区分风格轴为{a,a}与{b,b}。第一个新袋的六种二记录子集里四种含a和b，所以2/3的均匀重组变成两个{a,b}袋。这样的同一轴混合不是原固定账号style机制产生的事件。若k仅识别该轴相同，原正账号对分数0，两个混合袋分数1/2，重组期望1/3；不同控制者用另外两种风格，跨控制者分数仍为0。该例说明标签条件增强可制造便于分类的共有混合成分信号。概率2/3只属于这个明确2+2条件例，不是本项目正式数据发生率，更不是已测BGE捷径。
69: 
70: 接受支持集改变及潜在捷径判断；不接受将其升级为“增强必然有害”“新架构必然输”。重组保持关系标签，却没有足够论据表明它实现了当前任务需要的不变性。C/S共享增强也不能替代这一问题。
71: 
72: 另一个确定代价来自预测族本身。对固定Y，记录对均值评分必满足
73: s(X_mix,Y)=alpha s(X_a,Y)+(1-alpha)s(X_b,Y)，
74: 其中X_mix的经验分布是两个经验分布的该凸组合。重新训练BGE与记录头仍不能破坏这个恒等式。若两种纯账号都应高分、其混合却因内部不一致而低分，新结构无法表示。原账号均值/标准差后的非线性头可以表达某些这种方差/一致性规则。反过来，新结构也可能保留旧池化压缩丢失的信息，故不声称旧模型全面包含新模型。
75: 
76: 原稿坦白了这些风险，但坦白风险不等于建立正向动机。当前还没有证据表明LOGIT的关键瓶颈正是只能查询原账号组合，或新增记录表方向恰好可迁移到旧域未见身份。精确保留来源在该重组族上的选择，仍可能只更完整保存其偏差。
77: 
78: 也不能把第一反例中的两个来源解称作“完整增强训练目标等价”：来源从首域就接受两视图监督，其表项并非完全未受约束。成立的结论只是原378输出不能唯一确定更多查询；有限增强监督是否足以让额外查询可靠仍未证实。
79: 
80: 五、最近邻的独立处置
81: 
82: 本轮独立读取CKD作者版v1的§3.1—3.3及RKD的§3.2；CKD正式WACV PDF打开失败，不能将v1方法细节写成已核对正式版全文。
83: 
84: CKD：https://arxiv.org/html/2311.02253v1
85: §3.3把已缓存教师表示随机分组，按质心聚合后比较，无须新增教师调用。这支持“缓存可组合目标产生更多关系监督”已有直接基础。CKD的向量差/softmax/KL与本稿标量记录对表/账号分数/MSE不逐式相同；本稿不是因此被证明完全同法。
86: 
87: RKD：https://arxiv.org/html/1904.05068
88: §3.2式(4)将关系势作为传递对象，距离/角度实例允许某些内部表示变化。这支持“只约束关系可见信息”是旧原则，不证明它已覆盖本稿全部L_A结构。
89: 
90: 原稿已经承认Multi-Instance Kernels的集合聚合、DER的历史输出、FunMatch的同增强匹配，以及PseMix/持续MIL的袋重组与细粒度记忆；本轮复用其原阅读说明，没有把外审新增ConSlide/ReMix摘要升级为自己已读全文。
91: 
92: 主执行者的推断是：本案真实区别在于刻意选取可分解模型，把一个有限输入族上的教师查询写成可存表接口；但数学闭合主要是该分解的直接后果，尚无足够证据使这一取舍超出自然适配并优先值得投入。没有作“绝对无创新”或“单篇已完全覆盖”的事实断言。
93: 
94: 六、对照与资源意见的处置
95: 
96: C/S比较有意义，后续阶段各用自身来源也正确。但蒸馏部分实际为
97: C=0.25 MSE_0+0.25 MSE_1，S=0.50 MSE_0。
98: 所以C−S比较的是保护权重从原输入向新分配重新分配的完整策略，不能单独证明新增查询信息的净贡献。L_A1 d=0、L_A0 d!=0时，C仅施加S一半惩罚。原稿已说明质量分配，需收窄“隔离查询范围”的解释，不将S判为无效对照。若未来确有正收益并需要净信息归因，再由具体新合同考虑原分配半权重对照；本轮不新增第三臂。
99: 
100: F的平方应施于加权误差，即F=d^T diag(Q_hat)d，而非sum L*d²或均匀全表MSE。它去交叉项，但不自动匹配真实梯度强度。F/同实际计算直接重放是有条件的后续建议，不成为被否决候选当前必须执行的消融。
101: 
102: 六张最大FP32表599,424B是确定算术，完整813,405B仍为跨旧格式差额估算，8,192B是估计；原稿已披露，不能指控为已发生超限或隐瞒。实际若用JSON十进制数组就不能按每值4B计。所有历史正文/token、标签、索引、来源、RNG及持久附属状态仍需纳入1MiB。
103: 
104: 最大头第一层乘法比约33.04成立，但不是全模型实测慢33倍；分块头重算、BGE编码/反传/激活重算、来源表构建与推理另计。没有候选资源实测，不批准或否决具体GPU容量。
105: 
106: 4,320物理更新、15个不重复物理状态、18个逻辑阶段点的算术成立。“15独立模型点”应改称“15个不重复物理模型状态”，不具有统计独立性。既有按实际域配对整群bootstrap可复用其定义；不能把重复顺序贡献独立重采样，也不能让已开发valid重新成为确认集。CPU180秒/GPU600秒/24GPU小时、所有比较和继续门均没有转为执行许可。
